fusions.name: Razor Swipe
fusions.desc: A thin cutting swipe that deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: Stamps down on the target for 14 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Terms of Protection
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine Print
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
